_: Runtime strings for language `en`. Plugin source stays English; only what the user reads (journals, loaded context, CLAUDE.md block) is localized. Add a language by copying this file to <code>.json - missing or broken keys fall back to en. Keep {placeholders} exactly as they are. In sessions_header the example entry MUST stay indented (4 spaces): a `## ` heading at column 0 would be read as a real entry.
prompts_header:
# Prompt journal (automatic)

Written by the ZoeyMemory hooks: a marker per session plus every prompt the user sends.
This file is COMMITTED so the other machine can see what this one was asked to do.

Do not hand-edit the automatic lines. To record the OUTCOME of a task, add a line starting with `> `
right under the matching prompt. The REASONING behind a decision belongs in OpenSpec (`openspec/changes/<name>/`).
sessions_header:
# Session journal

Every time you leave a machine (`/zoey-memory:handoff`) append ONE new entry at the end, shaped like this
(the example is indented on purpose; real entries start at column 0):

    ## YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM - branch `main` - machine <hostname>
    - In progress: ...
    - Why we stopped: ...
    - Waiting on whom for what: ...
    - The other machine needs to know (things outside git): ...

The session-start hook loads the LATEST entry into the next session. Do not repeat `git log` -
commits answer "what changed", this entry answers "why, and what comes next".
ctx_intro: Read all of this BEFORE answering the first prompt. It is what happened in the previous session and/or ON THE OTHER MACHINE - do not re-ask what is already answered here, do not re-propose options already rejected. Division of labor: specs/decisions -> OpenSpec (/opsx:*) - TDD/debugging/verification/review -> superpowers - memory -> ZoeyMemory. Details in CLAUDE.md.
cfg_invalid: WARNING: ZoeyMemory is enabled here but `{path}` could not be read ({reason}). Journaling, git sync and context loading are OFF until it is fixed - tell the user, then run `/zoey-memory:doctor`.
render_failed: WARNING: ZoeyMemory could not render the session context ({error}). Journals and config are untouched; run `/zoey-memory:doctor`.
sync_fetch_slow: WARNING: git fetch took over 8s (slow/offline network?) - the origin comparison below may be STALE; no pull was attempted.
sync_fetch_failed: WARNING: git fetch failed (offline? auth?) - the origin comparison below may be STALE; no pull was attempted.
sync_pulled: OK: auto `git pull --ff-only` brought in {n} new commit(s) from {upstream} (tree was clean, so it was safe). FILES ON DISK JUST CHANGED - anything you remember about this repo may be outdated.
sync_pull_slow: WARNING: branch is BEHIND {upstream} by {n} commit(s); the auto-pull was stopped after 20s. Run `git pull --ff-only` yourself before continuing.
sync_pull_failed: WARNING: branch is BEHIND {upstream} by {n} commit(s) and `git pull --ff-only` FAILED (network, auth, or a non-fast-forward). Run it yourself and read the error before continuing.
sync_behind_no_pull: WARNING: branch is BEHIND {upstream} by {n} commit(s) (as of the last successful fetch) but the network is not healthy, so no pull was attempted. Run `git pull --ff-only` when it is back.
sync_dirty: WARNING: branch is BEHIND {upstream} by {n} commit(s) but the working tree has UNCOMMITTED CHANGES, so no auto-pull. Settle the in-progress work (commit/stash) and `git pull` BEFORE continuing.
sync_diverged: WARNING: branch is BEHIND {upstream} by {n} commit(s) and has DIVERGED (local commits not pushed). Needs a deliberate rebase/merge - ask the user before deciding.
sync_unpushed: WARNING: {n} commit(s) from the previous session are NOT PUSHED - `git push` soon or the other machine will not see them.

note_clipped: [... {n} characters cut from the middle of this note - read it in full in {path} ...]
